finding.problem: valid_until=None was semantically labeled UNBOUNDED_UNKNOWN but still authorized uncertain mutating retries indefinitely.
finding.risk: Provider idempotency retention can expire or be pruned; after retention loss, reuse of an old key can become a new external effect.
finding.counterhypothesis: mismatch rejection plus duplicate-result observability is sufficient even when the provider retention horizon is unknown.
finding.reason: Retry safety depends on the provider still recognizing the key. Unknown retention cannot establish that predicate. Read-only reconciliation is a separate operation and does not mint replay authority.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.fact: Idempotency keys may be removed after at least 24 hours; reuse after pruning is treated as a new request.

semantic_delta: unknown provider retention -> PROVIDER_IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION_UNKNOWN -> retry denied
expired provider retention -> PROVIDER_IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION_EXPIRED -> retry denied
known live retention -> same-intent retry remains admissible when all other provider contract predicates hold
read-only reconciliation remains separately admissible when reconciliation_lookup_supported is true
